Who We Are

Oklahoma Hazmat & Remediation (OHR) was founded in 2024 to meet the growing need for fast, professional, and reliable hazardous material cleanup across Oklahoma and surrounding areas. With over 35 years of combined industry experience, our team specializes in handling emergencies with precision, safety, and care.

Highway spill cleanup is at the core of what we do. From fuel and oil releases to cargo and chemical spills, OHR responds rapidly to contain, clean, and restore affected areas to safe conditions. Our specialized equipment and trained technicians ensure that roadways are cleared quickly to minimize environmental impact, traffic disruption, and risk to the public. We coordinate closely with local authorities and transportation agencies to manage every incident efficiently and professionally—day or night, anywhere in the region.

Beyond highway cleanup, we provide a full range of services including biohazard and crime scene cleanup, industrial spill response, natural disaster recovery, livestock recovery certified by the Oklahoma Department of Agriculture, and commercial vehicle accident cleanup. Whether it’s a small-scale incident or a large emergency, OHR has the expertise and resources to respond effectively.

Our mission is simple: protect people, property, and the environment while delivering peace of mind to every client we serve. We operate 24/7, because emergencies don’t wait—and neither do we. At OHR, we combine professionalism with compassion, ensuring every job is done safely, thoroughly, and respectfully.

Oklahoma Hazmat & Remediation (OHR) provides fast, reliable, and professional cleanup for hazardous materials, biohazards, and highway spills across Oklahoma and surrounding areas. Our highly trained team responds quickly to industrial accidents, commercial vehicle incidents, natural disasters, and other emergencies—protecting people, property, and the environment while minimizing impact.

Highway spill response is a primary focus for OHR. From fuel and chemical releases to large-scale vehicle accidents, we act swiftly to contain hazards, remove debris, and restore safety. Our crews coordinate closely with local authorities, transportation agencies, and property owners, following strict safety protocols to ensure every cleanup is efficient, thorough, and fully compliant with regulations. Every response is carefully planned to minimize disruption, prevent secondary hazards, and reduce environmental impact.

No job is too large or complex. Our team is certified in livestock recovery by the Oklahoma Department of Agriculture and experienced in biohazard and industrial cleanup, including crime scenes, unattended deaths, bloodborne hazards, and industrial spill planning. We combine decades of hands-on experience with modern techniques, state-of-the-art equipment, and a commitment to safety, community, and environmental responsibility to handle every situation with precision and care.

Operating 24/7, OHR brings professionalism, compassion, and attention to detail to every job. We take pride in restoring affected areas to safe, fully functional conditions, giving clients peace of mind, confidence, and reassurance in our rapid, effective, and reliable response—no matter the size, urgency, or complexity of the incident.
